page.overview:
Who is Tracker?

Tracker is one of the new members of the G.I. Joe Extreme team along with his pet dog Lakota. He's also a former member of S.K.A.R., and an expert tracker recruited by Stone, in order to find Clancy. Tracker possesses extra-sensory perception.
